description_html:
In a set covering (SC) instance, we are given \(m\) elements and a collection \(S\) of \(n\) sets whose union is the set of all elements, each set having a cost. The goal is to select a minimum-cost subcollection of \(S\) whose union is still the set of all elements.

All levels are generated with the generator of [Gasse19] (the very hard levels of [Huang23], which follow [Wu21], use the same generator), which follows Balas and Ho (1980): the element-set incidence matrix has a fixed density of 0.05 (exactly \(\lfloor 0.05\,mn\rfloor\) nonzeros), every element belongs to at least one set, every set contains at least 2 elements, and the set costs are integers drawn uniformly from \(\{1,\dots,100\}\).

Notation.

  • \(U=\{1,\dots,m\}\): elements; \(S\): collection of \(n\) sets, each \(s\in S\) a subset of \(U\).
  • \(c_s\in\{1,\dots,100\}\): cost of set \(s\in S\).
  • \(x_s\in\{0,1\}\): 1 if set \(s\) is selected.

Formulation.

\begin{align} \min\ & \sum_{s\in S} c_s x_s \\ \textrm{s.t.}\ & \sum_{s\in S:\, i\in s} x_s \geq 1, && \forall i\in U, \\ & x_s\in\{0,1\}, && \forall s\in S. \end{align}

There is one covering constraint per element (\(m\) constraints) and one binary variable per set (\(n\) variables).
changes: Objective corrected from 'minimum number of sets' (sum x_s) to weighted cost sum c_s x_s with integer costs uniform in {1,...,100}: all checked instances have such costs.

Added generator description (Balas & Ho 1980 scheme via Gasse19 generator, density 0.05, each element covered by >=1 set, each set has >=2 elements). New reference if wanted: E. Balas and A. Ho, Set covering algorithms using cutting planes, heuristics, and subgradient optimization: a computational study, Mathematical Programming Study 12 (1980) 37-60.
Added Density column (0.05 for all levels) and Set Cost column. #Element/#Set values are correct (Medium really is 1,000 elements x 1,000 sets; Very hard 2 is 5,000 x 8,000).
verification: Generator: learn2branch generate_setcover(nrows, ncols, density=0.05, max_coef=100): 500r/1000c train, 1000r and 2000r transfer. Local generator_MVC_MIS_CA_SC_MK.py has the identical function (used for the setcover_%d_%d very-hard sets).
SC/easy test 0,1: 1000 binaries, 500 rows '>= 1', 25,000 nonzeros (density 0.0500), costs integer 1..100, every set covers 10-42 elements.
SC/medium test 0,1: 1000 x 1000 rows, 50,000 nnz (0.05), costs 1..100.
SC/hard test 0,1: 1000 vars, 2000 rows, 100,000 nnz (0.05), costs 1..100.
SC/very-hard test 0,1 (present on HF although hf_tree.txt listed no files): 4000 vars, 5000 rows, 1,000,000 nnz (0.05), costs 1..100.
Very hard 2 not on HF: local table_raw.csv lists SetCovering_CL-LNS_LB-RELAX/5000_8000 with 8000 binaries, 5000 constraints; Huang23 Table 1 SC-L 8,000 vars, 5,000 constraints.
open_questions: Very hard 2 density/costs not checked on an instance (not on HF); assumed the same generator as Very hard (same source directory family SetCovering_CL-LNS_LB-RELAX).
